<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/rest/report/chats"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the individual messages of up to **10 conversations** at a time, together with
the conversation records they belong to.

Obtain the conversation UUIDs from **Get conversations data**.
